text:
nina: Heads-up for the cross-vendor sync tomorrow 9:30am PT. Goal: lock press embargo windows and SI ramp for H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi, B200. Quick check: who can commit to an SI dry-run before public?

chetan: I can run the MI300 canary funnel and provide nightly artifacts. Driver GA still a range; vendor expects mid-Apr. Will publish canary tags `mi300-canary-<date>`.

yasmin: Marketplace ops: we support hidden prelist for SIs and a public flip when `signed_driver_checksum` + `driver_signoff` are present. Need SKU taxonomy by EOD.

leo: SI lead here. We need two dry-run cycles and perf targets. Gaudi lab availability is tight; ask vendors to confirm rack windows.

nina: Proposed stagger to limit press overlap:
- Phase A: SI-only hidden listings and partner previews (H100, Gaudi)
- Phase B: Marketplace hidden->published (MI300, B200) after driver signoff
- Phase C: Public blog + press (H200)

chetan: I'll attach a `fallback_map` if H200 slips: `H200 -> H100,B200` and test routing in staging.

yasmin: Adding runbook entries: `quote_review_window: 48h` (vendor requested), `embargo_lead: 72h` (marketing preferred). Will reconcile with legal.

leo: I'll circulate SI signup and smoke test matrix (checks: basic infer, batching stability, KV cache restore). Need signups by Fri.

partner-bot: Vendor contacts sheet: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/partners (shared). Calendar invite created: "Vendor HW launch dry-run" 9:30am PT https://calendar.redwood.com/event/1734567890-dryrun

nina: Action owners: Chetan -> canary artifacts + fallback mapping; Yasmin -> marketplace gating + SKU list; Leo -> SI dry-run plan + signup. Everyone -> review embargo windows in the invite doc.

chetan: Small ask: can CI run nightly smoke tests against canary images and publish results to the shared bucket? That will speed SI onboarding.

yasmin: Yes, gate for public flip will require `ci_smoke_pass == true` and `signed_driver_checksum` present.

nina: Great. If any vendor date moves, ping this thread so we can slide windows quickly. :thumbsup:
